rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for sending a letter or parcel through the post.

example.english: I’ll mail a document to you tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 gei3 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 nei5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for electronic mail and email messages.

example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 din6 jau4

rows.note: Use this when sending something by electronic mail rather than through the post.

example.english: I’ll mail the document to you by email now.
example.traditional: 我而家電郵份文件畀你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 din6 jau4 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for physical mail such as letters and parcels handled by the postal service.

example.english: This piece of mail needs to be sent to Canada.
example.traditional: 呢份郵件要寄去加拿大。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 jau4 gin2 jiu3 gei3 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6

rows.note: Use this for the postal service or postal system as an institution.

example.english: The mail service has improved its delivery service.
example.traditional: 郵政署已經改善派信服務。
example.jyutping: jau4 zing3 syu5 ji5 ging1 goi2 sin6 paai3 seon3 fuk6 mou6
